issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 05 asks for the average area (durchschnittliche Fläche) per Landkreis including the Landkreis name and Regierungsbezirk and sorted by Landkreis name, but the solution query uses COUNT(flaeche) instead of AVG(flaeche). This is a structural mismatch between the specification and the reference solution and will confuse students about which aggregate to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to compute the average area using AVG(flaeche) (and keep grouping by kreis and regierungsbezirk), e.g. SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis. Alternatively, if the intended exercise was to count municipalities, change the problem text to request a count instead of the average.
